title: AI-Powered Exam Preparation & Assessment Platform (Full-Stack Distributed SaaS Architecture)
description: Architected an AI-powered examination & assessment platform using Next.js 15, React 18, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase Auth, Stripe, and Docker.
Designed a layered system architecture with SSR/CSR rendering, REST APIs, secure internal service communication, and containerized deployment via Docker Compose.
Built a modular frontend with Next.js App Router, protected routes, reusable components, and a hybrid exam engine combining React with vanilla JavaScript modules.
Implemented Firebase Auth + Admin SDK authentication with JWT verification middleware and RBAC-based access control (free, premium, admin roles).
Developed Stripe-based billing system with subscriptions, recurring payments, webhook processing, renewals, cancellations, promo codes, and payment reconciliation.
Built LLM-based AI scoring pipeline for writing/speaking tasks using structured prompts, JSON outputs, rubric-based evaluation, and stored feedback analytics.
Designed normalized PostgreSQL schema for users, content taxonomy, exams, AI scores, payments, audit logs, login history, and system configuration.
Implemented secure asset streaming via tokenized endpoints and backend validation for protected exam media delivery.
Built admin system for user management, content sync, taxonomy editing, promo codes, email templates, analytics, audit logs, and monitoring tools.
Added production security: Helmet.js headers, CORS policies, rate limiting, webhook signature verification, and centralized error logging.
Integrated external services (Stripe, Firebase, SMTP, LLM APIs) with resilient, fault-tolerant workflows and structured observability.
Containerized full stack using Docker with isolated services, environment configs, and production-ready deployment orchestration.
